security_audit.summary: Most static detections are Markdown formatting false positives, including code fences, inline literals, and abbreviated URL paths. The confirmed static issue is expected RunComfy network egress, and one semantic provenance issue needs correction. No prompt injection attempt was found.

remediation.suggestion: Update GitHub links and install commands to the audited repository, or document why agentspace-so/runcomfy-skills is the canonical source.
Keep clear disclosure that prompts, reference image URLs, and bearer tokens are sent to RunComfy for processing.
Recommend trusted RunComfy CLI installation, version pinning where practical, and secure token handling in local and CI environments.

content.user_title: Generate GPT Image 2 Images on RunComfy
content.value_statement: Image teams need precise visuals with readable text and stable edits. This skill guides GPT Image 2 generation and editing through RunComfy.
actual_capabilities: Runs the RunComfy GPT Image 2 text-to-image endpoint.
Runs the RunComfy GPT Image 2 edit endpoint with reference image URLs.
Documents supported output sizes and edit size preservation.
Guides prompts for embedded text, product imagery, signage, and localization.
Explains CLI polling, result downloads, exit codes, and token handling.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI and a RunComfy account or token.
Sends prompts and reference image URLs to RunComfy servers.
Text-to-image supports only three fixed output sizes.
Multi-image edits use references as guidance, not exact control layers.

use_cases.title: Create Product Listing Images
use_cases.description: Generate clean product visuals with short label text and consistent studio lighting.

use_cases.title: Localize Brand Assets
use_cases.description: Adapt signs, posters, and package mockups with short multilingual text.

use_cases.title: Refine Existing Visuals
use_cases.description: Edit backgrounds, composition, or text while preserving the main subject.

prompt_templates.title: Simple Product Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a square product image with GPT Image 2. Use a clean studio setting, one short label, and soft light.

prompt_templates.title: Preserve Subject Edit
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this reference image with GPT Image 2. Keep the subject identity and pose unchanged, but replace the background with a bright studio.

prompt_templates.title: Localized Signage
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a cafe sign concept. Render the exact text "OPEN STUDIO" and make the typography clear at normal viewing size.

prompt_templates.title: Multi-Reference Composition
prompt_templates.prompt: Use image 1 as the product and image 2 as the lighting reference. Keep packaging text unchanged and match the room perspective.

output_examples.input: A user requests a square e-commerce product visual with short label text.
output_examples.output: The skill prepares a GPT Image 2 generation request and saves the resulting image files in the selected output folder.

output_examples.input: A user provides a product image URL and asks for a background change.
output_examples.output: The skill uses the edit endpoint, preserves the product, and downloads the completed RunComfy result.

output_examples.input: A user asks whether GPT Image 2 is the right model for multilingual signage.
output_examples.output: The skill explains that GPT Image 2 is suited for short embedded text, layout precision, and brand mockups.

best_practices: Use short exact text when asking for labels, signs, or packaging.
Change one visual attribute per edit when preserving composition matters.
Use size auto for edits unless the user asks for a new frame.
anti_patterns: Do not send private images or prompts unless RunComfy processing is acceptable.
Do not combine many unrelated style directions in one prompt.
Do not expect exact control-layer behavior from multi-reference edits.

faq.question: Does this skill call OpenAI directly?
faq.answer: No. It uses GPT Image 2 through the RunComfy Model API and RunComfy CLI.

faq.question: Do I need a RunComfy account?
faq.answer: Yes. The CLI needs a RunComfy login or a RUNCOMFY_TOKEN value.

faq.question: Can it edit multiple reference images?
faq.answer: Yes. The edit endpoint accepts up to ten public HTTPS reference image URLs.

faq.question: Which image sizes are supported?
faq.answer: Text-to-image supports square, portrait, and landscape sizes documented by the skill.

faq.question: Is it good for text inside images?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill recommends GPT Image 2 for short embedded text, signs, labels, and logos.

faq.question: Where are generated files saved?
faq.answer: The RunComfy CLI downloads generated outputs into the output directory chosen for the command.
